meta.name: Savage Beauty
meta.description:
Seeking revenge for her tragic past, a mysterious woman embeds herself in a powerful family who possess a global beauty empire — and dark secrets.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 12 May 2022 · South Africa · Language: English

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 6/6

On your server — Audio: English (from file names)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Bhengu family celebrates the new face of their beauty brand when a PR fiasco erupts. Later, matriarch Grace handles a different kind of obstacle.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Intent on choosing his successor, Don shows his children Phila and Linda the other side of the Bhengu Beauty business. Zinhle plots her next move.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: An explosive video brings more drama for the Bhengus as Zinhle spends more time with Ndu, Linda is forced to leave, and Grace puts the family first.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As a scandal and the disappearance of a close family friend cause a deeper rift among the Bhengus, Zinhle and Bonga confront a figure from their past.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Zinhle's plan involving Don puts her in a precarious position. Linda looks for a leak at the Emerald party as Bonga looks for help in an unlikely place.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With wedding plans underway, Zinhle tries to take down Bhengu Beauty once and for all before it's too late. Grace takes matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A shocking family tragedy creates rifts in the Bhengu dynasty. A somber event sets the stage for family infighting.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Don recovers, he is plagued by premonitions of the past. Grace settles into her new role, while Phila hatches plans of his own.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When the Bhengu family holds a press conference to project unity, a surprising allegation sends everyone into a frenzy — and creates opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Business and pleasure get entangled in a series of steamy seductions. Phila prepares his ambitious plan, but betrayals lurk around the corner.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Don tries to keep another explosive situation under wraps. Phila makes a bold move that could change the future of Bhengu Beauty.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The board votes on a new CEO. Grace makes a heart wrenching decision to try and make things right once and for all.
